Method of Attack: Automated deployment of Monero mining program using GitHub Action to create Replit accounts, instantiate Replit environments, clone mining program repositories, and start mining
Use of GitHub Action for full automation including account creation, login, app instance creation, program download and execution
Proxy mining pool configuration to evade detection
Discoverer: 奇安信星图实验室供应链安全团队
Attack Vector: GitHub Action automated workflow triggering Python scripts
Exploitation of Replit free online IDE environment without email verification
Cloning malicious git repositories containing mining software and scripts
